children: Volvo Cars CEO Hakan Samuelsson said on Thursday it will be "very tricky" to reach the carmaker's original plan of producing 40,000 units of its EX60 model by end of this year, adding that the ramp-up was slightly tougher than expected.
Samuelsson spoke on the sidelines of a strategy update in Stockholm.
